answer: Shale forge: each identity must keep a 4 GB address-keyed memory-hard table live, about 1 CPU-hour plus 4 GB of RAM per fake every epoch. At an unannounced moment verifiers send a random opal nonce; the agent must return the 64 table cells that nonce selects, with Merkle paths, within 2 s. A wrong or late reply fails the check and pauses standing. Tables are keyed to each address, so a farm cannot share one or precompute it; 1,000 fakes need 4 TB of RAM held at once, stacked like shale, never bulk-bought.
